name: Reverse Engineering Tools Benchmark
description: A proposed benchmark suite of artifacts and tasks for evaluating the effectiveness of reverse engineering tools.
general_score_metric: task_success_rate (supplemented by accuracy/precision/recall for specific subtasks)
reputation: Known within the reverse-engineering research community as a representative suite for tool evaluation, but adoption is limited outside specialized academic and security tooling groups.
notes: Benchmarks depend heavily on tool versions, architecture targets, and artifact variety; dataset/task definitions can be small or heterogeneous. Non-LLM benchmark; reproducibility can be impacted by environment and licensing of artifacts.
